name: videos
description: PROPOSAL / STUB — not installable yet (no binary). simplicio-videos: Simplicio Runtime plugin that turns 'I want a video' into a deterministic pipeline: intake questionnaire (auto-extraction from site/Instagram) -> brief/spec (single source of truth) -> sector template -> HyperFrames composition from the motion pattern library -> TTS voice (gemini/elevenlabs/xai/local/file, cached) -> optional video-use footage edit -> deterministic render + QA. LLM (Opus 5.5) only authors new templates/patterns. See docs/decisoes/ADR-0001-visao-plugin.md and docs/esteira.md.

commands.description: Run the simplicio-videos pipeline steps (proposal): intake, brief, template, compose, voice, edit, check, render, batch; plus catalog lookups for motion patterns, templates and voice providers.

op.description: intake: questionnaire state/validation (intake/intake.schema.json); brief: intake -> brief + spec; template: pick/list sector templates; patterns: list motion library; voices: list providers; new: scaffold video from template; compose: mount motion blocks from spec; voice: generate/cached TTS; edit: video-use EDL for footage; handoff: prompt for Opus 5.5 authoring; check/render/batch: deterministic build.

site.description: public site URL for intake auto-extraction (op=intake)

instagram.description: public Instagram handle/URL for intake auto-extraction (op=intake)
